video_goal: Demonstrate how to reveal hidden formatting marks and delete an unwanted blank page in Microsoft Word for Microsoft 365.
required_subjects_and_props: Microsoft Word for Microsoft 365 (Windows desktop), computer mouse, physical keyboard

outline_steps.visual_action: The screen displays a Microsoft Word document with text on the first page and an entirely blank second page.
The mouse cursor moves to the top ribbon of the Microsoft Word 365 interface and hovers over the 'Home' tab.
The cursor clicks the 'Home' tab, expanding the ribbon to show the Clipboard, Font, and Paragraph tool groups.
The cursor moves to the Paragraph group and hovers directly over the 'Show/Hide ¶' button, which looks like a paragraph mark.
The cursor clicks the 'Show/Hide ¶' button, instantly causing blue paragraph marks (¶) and formatting dots to appear throughout the document text.
The screen scrolls down to the blank second page, revealing a dotted line containing the words 'Page Break' and several empty blue paragraph marks (¶).
The cursor clicks at the beginning of the 'Page Break' dotted line and drags down to highlight it along with the empty paragraph marks in gray.
A human finger presses down on the 'Delete' key on a physical computer keyboard.
The highlighted 'Page Break' line and the gray-highlighted paragraph marks instantly disappear from the Word document.
The view instantly shifts up as the blank page vanishes, snapping the bottom of the document directly to the end of the text on the first page.
The cursor moves back up to the top ribbon and clicks the 'Show/Hide ¶' button a second time.
All the blue paragraph marks (¶) and formatting dots disappear from the screen, leaving only the clean text.
The screen scrolls smoothly up and down the document, visually confirming that the blank page is gone and only one page remains.
